slides.title: What does the EU ask of Ethiopia and Eritrea?
Immediate de-escalation
slides.body: The EU calls for it on all fronts, and for restraint in actions and rhetoric.

slides.title: Back to the AU framework
slides.body: Parties to the Cessation of Hostilities Agreement should recommit to it, the EU says.

slides.title: Civilians and aid access
slides.body: The EU says civilians must be protected and humanitarian access unhindered.

slides.title: Protect civilians, choose dialogue
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: EU High Representative statement, Oct 5, 2026
